comments.reviewNegatives:
I was in room 709 : 
❌ The noise : Unfortunately, we were on the road side. And the insulation is really bad. That means that we could hear cars CONSTANTLY, as in day and night. My husband really didn't sleep well for the 4 nights we were there. I (luckily) had brought earplugs and an eyemask. 
❌ The mold : in the shower and in the AC system... Like, when you turned on the AC, especially in the living room, it smelled like mold... So it was either that, either sweating all the time from the 34 degrees outside. 
❌ The wifi : It basically didn't work. They share 2 wifi boxes for each floor, so everyone uses the same one. And pretty much everytime you try to connect to it, it doesn't work or is really bad. So I had to get an expensive E-sim, as I needed to be able to work on my computer.
comments.reviewPositives:
✅ Location was excellent : It's really central. So it's just a 10/15 minute walk to ICON Siam. And that is really nice! + As everywhere in Thailand pretty much, there is a 7-Eleven 5 minutes away. 
✅ Staff was perfect : very nice, very helpful, always smiling. I had several questions, needed some change for the washing machines (twice!) and other things and they were always great! They dropped off 2 bottles of water, toilet paper and coffee at our door, without knocking, every day. 
✅ Amenities : Lovely rooftop area with a pool, seatings, little lights in the evening. Well equipped gym area. Restaurant at the ground floor. Washing and drying machines that worked really well, only 30baht. Lots of seating space in the lobby, which is pretty, by the way. 
✅ Room : Overall, it was good. 2 rooms, with a living room space, a kitchen, a big fridge with freezer, a balcony.
comments.reviewTitle: Great staff, lovely amenities, well located, but very noisy, quite moldy and terrible wifi...
